scientific_integrity: Proof derived from the published facet inequality description and independently specified simplex-tail/overlap integration. Finite computational checks are corroborating, not proof of the asymptotic. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer n>=5 only; implicit constants depend on n. The next exponential volume layers and all exact volume formulas for n>4 are not proved. Possible uncatalogued prior equivalent derivations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Two leading exponential volume corrections for fixed-label partial permutohedra
